Hi team —

Happy Monday. Per our contract sig, I'm looping Mina (CS lead) and Monica (implementation manager) in to kick off the MAP and lock in the implementation milestones. Proposed approach below:

- Week 0 (Jun 14): Official handoff + kickoff meeting (60m) — participants: Lunaris PMs, Redwood CS, infra lead
- Sprint 1 (Jun 21–Jul 2): Integration and test dataset ingest — Redwood infra + Lunaris SRE
- Sprint 2 (Jul 5–Jul 16): Prompt tuning + evaluation harness — Redwood MLOps + Lunaris data team
- Go‑live (target Jul 30): Canary deploy + smoke tests, then full cutover

Attached: Lunaris-SOW-draft.pdf and a short Redwood kickoff agenda.

Asks for Lunaris before kickoff: list of primary contacts (SRE, data, PM), firewall/egress IP allowlist window, and any preferred downtime for connectors.

Mina — can you take primary ownership for the MAP doc and propose assignments for the internal roster? Monica — please confirm who will run the integration sprint. Alex/Tara — any immediate conflicts with these target dates?

Thanks,
Marissa

--
